purpose: Final machine inventory of the frozen Study 4 evaluation exclusion file. exclusions.jsonl is the ADDITIONAL file for build.py --exclude-texts; build.py always excludes the canonical development manifest itself. This inventory supersedes the v1 inventory, which is retained unchanged as inventory_v1_historical.json.

frozen.note: The JSON records are the v1 records byte for byte; the comment and alias lines follow them. Alias lines are extra identities of sources already in the records, not new sources.

n_normalised_identifiers.rule: build.read_exclusions (build.text_refs for JSON lines, build._norm_ref for plain lines; # lines skipped) and build.load_dev_exclusions(build.DEV_TEXTS)

pageid_lookup.note: lookup.json is the parsed result; batch_*.json are the raw Wikipedia API responses.

builders.note: clear_wiki.py, build_union.py and inventory.py built the v1 file and the v1 inventory; add_pageids.py appended the alias lines to make the frozen file. They are kept as run.

lint_config.note: Excludes only the four archived builders from ruff; final_inventory.py remains linted. This configuration builds nothing and changes no scientific output.

self_check.rule: for every development, fix-check and union record, build.exclusion_overlap([record], union) is non-empty and build.text_refs(record) is a subset of union; every alias line is in union

evaluation_build.source: docs/validation/study4-preregistration.md, 'The evaluation build, as frozen at stage 1'

decisions.source: README.md, 'Addendum, 2026-10-21: page ids, and the decisions on the open questions', decision 1
decisions.quote: The Study 1 CLEAR excerpts stay excluded. They were never used in Study 4 development, but excluding them costs little: about 800 eligible Level-3 Vital titles remain for 40 general texts.

decisions.decision: resolved: page ids looked up and appended as 331 alias lines
decisions.source: README.md, 'Addendum, 2026-10-21: page ids, and the decisions on the open questions', 'Page ids'
decisions.quote: 317 English Wikipedia records matched by title only. Their page ids were looked up through the public Wikipedia API on 2026-10-21.

decisions.decision: kept unchanged (324 records, no revid, simplewiki: source ids); the README makes no separate dated decision, and the prereg adopts the recommendation
decisions.quote: I recommend keeping these titles, to be conservative: Study 3 paired each Simple text with its English counterpart on the same topic, so the same title points at closely related content.

decisions.source: README.md, 'Addendum, 2026-10-21: page ids, and the decisions on the open questions', decision 2
decisions.quote: The fetched-then-rejected candidates stay excluded. The registered exclusion rule covers every text "collected or inspected", and these were downloaded.

decisions.decision: not matched; none are recorded locally
decisions.source: README.md, 'Addendum, 2026-10-21: page ids, and the decisions on the open questions', decision 3
decisions.quote: PMIDs: none are recorded locally, and `build.py` doesn't match on them. Europe PMC texts are matched on PMCID, both URLs, DOI and title.

decisions.decision: the 2026-10-16 snapshot, byte-copied into the evaluation cache, no --refresh
decisions.source: README.md, 'Addendum, 2026-10-21: page ids, and the decisions on the open questions', decision 4
decisions.quote: The pools: the evaluation build uses the 2026-10-16 pool snapshot. A byte copy of `.cache/validation/study4/raw` is made into the evaluation build's own cache, with no `--refresh`. The development cache is never written to. If the pools were ever refreshed, the overlap check would be rerun on the refreshed pools.

decisions.topic: Freeze (README open question 6; not in the v1 inventory)
decisions.decision: frozen: this file's frozen.sha256 is the hash recorded in the prereg and passed unchanged through --exclude-texts
decisions.quote: Record this file's SHA-256 in the prereg and freeze file, and pass it unchanged through `--exclude-texts`. Any edit after a decision above means a new hash.

historical_v1.note: Historical: the 909-record file and its inventory before the 2026-10-21 page-id aliases. Their counts and open questions are not current; see decisions.

inventory.note: Byte copy of the former inventory.json. Its output_files entry names the pre-freeze cache path .cache/validation/study4_eval_exclusions/exclusions.jsonl with the v1 hash; that file is the v1 file above. Its pool_impact, not_excluded, input_manifests and raw-cache listings still describe the sources, but pool_impact was computed before the alias lines.
